answer: Sybils must replicate the full zephyr cost of staking and computation per fake identity, which scales linearly and becomes prohibitive. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then maintain a public reputation ledger. Peers cross-check via atlas, a shared registry of verified participants, and any whisper of duplicate behavior triggers slashing of the bond. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
